Courses at the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, IIT Guwahati.

## Current Semester

### [CS5187 — Software Analysis](cs-5187/index.html)

Monsoon 2026 · 23 July – 12 November. A graduate course on program analysis and software security: foundations and IRs, dataflow analysis and abstract interpretation, pointer and constraint-based analysis, type systems, symbolic execution, automated test generation, fuzzing, and LLM-assisted analysis.

### [Web Security](web-security/index.html)

A hands-on introduction to the security of modern web applications — the web threat model, OWASP Top 10, SQL injection, cross-site scripting, authentication, session management and hijacking, and secure coding practices, with session slides and student worksheets.

### CS1214 — Object Oriented Programming and Data Structure Lab

A laboratory course covering object-oriented programming principles and the design, implementation, and analysis of fundamental data structures — classes, inheritance, polymorphism, templates, lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, and hash tables.
